criteria_results.text: The PR desktop client launches against its live local API and engine, renders the core workspace and Agents surfaces at usable scale, and exposes healthy private mobile-access controls.
criteria_results.notes: Computer Control verified Dashboard, Tasks, Projects, Agents, a selected transcript, Settings, the ready localhost Agent Server card, and the pre-code Mobile Access dialog. The API, engine capabilities route, and restricted gateway health endpoints returned HTTP 200. RHYTHM_LOCAL_SMOKE=1 disabled the production-trigger watcher, no prompt was sent, and no pairing code was generated.

suggested_follow_up: Continue with the iOS simulator smoke and resolve the already-observed mobile-to-gateway contract mismatch before the final verification gate.
